regime_context: The detector shows a very narrow, one-narrative tape led by Coal (eligible, rank 1, but hurst_tag 'mean-revert') with Banks as the only other eligible theme (crowded, trend-like). Only 2 of 22 themes are eligible, backtest says the absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on this market's history (gate_helps=false), and the macro backdrop is 75% unscheduled headline share — so this is a whippy, attention-driven tape with no validated timing edge; conviction should be low.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Coal's leadership confirms a handoff to Banks: if Banks (512800.SS) closes above Coal (515220.SS) in relative-performance and holds the leadership for 5 consecutive sessions, that would retire the 'one-narrative Coal dominance' read and confirm the rotation the margin (0.07) is hinting at.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the most durable-looking leg in an otherwise thin tape: eligible, rank 2 just behind Coal, durability_bar 0.78 (highest of the top themes), hurst_tag 'trend', and breadth 0.944 — the only top theme with broad participation. The crowding flag (crowded=true, z=1.74) is a size-down caution only, not a fade. Lean is grounded in trend-health/breadth/durability, not the rank itself.
theses.dissent: Banks are crowded and the detector says this market mean-reverts (gate_helps=false); the whipsaw that breaks the trend gate is exactly the kind of tape that punishes chasing crowded laggards into the leader's own fade.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags CSI 300 by 4% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the nominal leader (rank 1, score 1.1) but its own texture argues against treating it as a durable hold: hurst_tag 'mean-revert', breadth only 0.5, and durability_bar 0.54 — modest. The one-narrative structure and mean-revert tag suggest leadership is fragile, and the detector's validated edge said 'did not hold here'. This is an avoid on durability grounds, not a fade or short.
theses.dissent: It is the market's one dominant narrative right now; in reflexive, one-narrative tapes the leader can persist far longer than mean-revert texture implies, and avoiding the leader is the documented failure mode the guardrails warn about.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS holds above CSI 300 for 14 consecutive sessions without a drawdown back through its 20-day mean

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
